## Introduction

This article uses synthetic data generated with [`prior-generator`](https://github.com/cetagostini/prior-generator) to explore MMM estimation on known-ground-truth worlds.

Two datasets are provided under `data/`:

- **`world_alpha.csv`** — seed 20260728 / 22
- **`world_beta.csv`** — seed 20260801 / 99

Both share the same causal structure: 10 channels (C1–C10), 2 controls (Z1–Z2), geometric adstock with `l_max=4`, and Michaelis-Menten saturation. The response `Y` is the synthetic sales series.
